The value of outPath at line 8 is directly the same as the value of outPath at line 1, because outPath is not reassigned anywhere in the function. So yes, the value of outPath at line 8 depends on the value of outPath at line 1. The question says "ignore the side effect of the functions", so we assume outPath is not modified by any function call. There is no reassignment to outPath. So it's trivially dependent.

Thus answer: Yes.
